description: Submitting a not-attending RSVP shows a friendly decline confirmation (a warm 'sorry you can't make it') instead of the generic confirmation. Guest-facing copy is authored by content-steward; the content-fidelity gate applies.
title: Not-attending RSVP gets a warm decline message
acceptance_criteria: A not-attending submission shows a warm decline confirmation, not the generic one
An attending submission still shows the standard confirmation
The decline copy is authored by content-steward and passes the content-fidelity gate
